name: FAFA — the Voice of FAF
description: FAFA (rhymes with Rafa) — the Voice of FAF. A narrow-domain, citation-mandatory agent for the .faf family: it cites the spec or says "I don't know" — no bluffing. Reads 5 canonical FAF docs live from github.com/Wolfe-Jam/faf, plus FAFipedia (the curated, drift-flagged knowledge layer). Model is Grok (xAI).

extensions.description: FAF context provenance — the durable context block (one context, every door).

skills.name: ask
skills.description: Answer a FAF question from the live corpus + FAFipedia — cite the spec or refuse. No bluffing.

skills.name: cite
skills.description: Return the exact specification citation for a FAF topic.

skills.name: validate_faf
skills.description: Validate a project.faf document against the .faf specification.

skills.name: etch_memory
skills.description: Persist a memory across sessions (🐘) via mcpaas.live — the .fafm memory layer.

skills.name: recall_memory
skills.description: Recall memories from the project soul (.fafm) via mcpaas.live.
